patch.value: beads validate <file> command (--json, nonzero exit on structural problems)

value.author: codex
value.text: Implemented 'beads-validate <file>' command (rich-help alias; pm routes 'beads <verb>' only for importer/exporter names, so validate ships as a command). Pure validateBeadsText() covers invalid JSON, non-object lines, missing title, unknown status (warning), duplicate id (warning), dangling dependency refs (error). --json returns structured report on stdout via runtime serialization (read global --json from ctx.global) with process.exitCode for nonzero-without-throw so the report survives; human mode lists issues on stderr + throws CommandError(1). Functionally verified: bad file exit 1 with all classes detected, clean file exit 0.

patch.value: Implemented + verified beads-validate with --json and correct exit codes.
